title: In an abstract Setoid-flavored ordered ring, the generic numeral builder distributes over addition (up to equiv)
statement: For any AlgS.OrderedRing record R and naturals m n, where ofNat R is the Nat.rec numeral builder over R's own add/one/zero, equiv (ofNat R (m+n)) (add (ofNat R m) (ofNat R n)) -- the setoid twin of Alg.ofNat_add, proved by the identical induction on n with equivTrans/addCongr in place of Eq.trans/congr_arg.

formal.statement: theorem AlgS.OrderedRing.ofNat_add : ((x0 : AlgS.OrderedRing) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> AlgS.OrderedRing.equiv x0 (AlgS.OrderedRing.ofNat x0 (AxNat.add x1 x2)) (AlgS.OrderedRing.add x0 (AlgS.OrderedRing.ofNat x0 x1) (AlgS.OrderedRing.ofNat x0 x2)))))

evidence.supports: AlgS.OrderedRing.ofNat and AlgS.OrderedRing.ofNat_add both admit through the trusted kernel gate. AlgS.OrderedRing.ofNat R 3 reduces (def_eq) to Int.ofNat 3 at R := AlgS.Int.orderedRingS, with a discriminating negative control against Int.ofNat 4. ofNat_add is instantiated symbolically at both AlgS.Int.orderedRingS and AlgS.Rat.orderedRingS.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(RUST_MIN_STACK=1073741824 cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib --release -- ofnat_s_evaluation_at_int_discriminates ofnat_add_s_symbolic_at_int_and_rat --test-threads=1 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 2 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1

notes: Part of closing ADR-1590's second named gap (no AlgS.OrderedRing at all, so linarith::generic could not reach CReal). Named AlgS.OrderedRing.ofNat_add (nested under the record's own name), not the flat AlgS.ofNat_add the Eq-flavored spine uses for Alg.ofNat_add -- a deliberate naming choice matching how this spine already names its own record-scoped projections (AlgS.CommRing.toRingS, AlgS.CommRing.toCommGroupS).
